summary: Happy City Holdings (BVI-domiciled, NASDAQ-listed, 6-K under the 1934 Act) disclosed the resignation of Chairman and Executive Director Tak Shing Lam effective September 18, 2026, with no stated disagreements, and the concurrent appointment of Feng Wang as Executive Director, Chair of the Board and CEO. The Board, Nominating Committee and Compensation Committee approved the change on September 14, 2026, alongside an employment agreement paying Wang HK$180,000 annually (about US$22,951), monthly. Wang, a Hong Kong ECM advisor with roughly 15 years of experience, previously served as a director of the wholly owned Happy City Developments unit starting February 9, 2026. Watch for any follow-on leadership or disclosure issues given the abrupt chair-to-CEO overlap.
